brand.name: Dreamwall
brand.structuralReference: units.gr — disciplined color blocks, thick rounded corners, charcoal outlines, confident bold type. Bold color contained by strict structure is what keeps the brand feeling professional rather than childish.

iris.usage: wordmark, headings on cream, hero block fill

coralDeep.usage: CTA fills only — never used as a block color

charcoal.usage: body text; text and borders on top of color blocks

hero.note: 800 inside hero/block contexts, 700 on plain cream

logo.note: Single weight, single color. No weight or color splitting within the word.

periodDetail.description: The period is a small rotated coral square (diamond/spark) instead of a plain dot — subtle, inspired by units.gr hiding a tiny house in their period. Barely visible at normal size; a quiet detail, not a focal point.

borderBlock.usage: outline on color-block cards — the discipline that keeps bold color feeling professional, not childish

hero.usage: landing hero or milestone/celebration screens only — never on dashboards or lists
